translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: Wuowi mariek kelo mor ni wuon mare,
to wuowi mofuwo miyo min mare chuny lit.
Mwandu moyudi e yo marach onge gi ohala;
to tim makare reso ji e tho.
Jehova Nyasaye ok we ngʼat makare obed gi kech,
to oketho gombo mar joricho.
Lwedo manyap miyo ngʼato bedo jachan,
to lwedo ma jakinda kelo mwandu.
Ngʼat makayo cham e kinde oro en wuowi mariek,
to ngʼat ma nindo kinde keyo en wuowi makwodo wich.
Gweth sidho kondo mar loch ewi ngʼat makare,
to timbe mahundu opongʼ e dho ngʼat marach.
Paro miparogo ngʼat makare nobed gweth,
to nying ngʼat marach nolal.
Ngʼat mariek e chunye rwako chike,
to ngʼat mofuwo ma wachne ngʼeny dhi e kethruok.
Ngʼat mobidhore wuotho kaonge luoro,
to ngʼatno maluwo yore mobam ibiro yudo mapiyo.
Ngʼat madiemo wangʼe giwuond kelo kuyo,
to ngʼat mofuwo ma wachne ngʼeny dhi e kethruok.
Dho ngʼat makare en soko mar ngima,
to timbe mahundu opongʼo dho ngʼat marach.
Sigu kelo miero,
to hera umo maricho duto.
Rieko iyudo e dho jogo mongʼeyo tiend wach,
to luth en mar ngʼe ngʼatno maonge gi rieko mar ngʼado bura.
Joma riek okano ngʼeyo,
to dho joma ofuwo kelo kethruok.
Mwandu mar jomoko e ohinga mochiel motegno ma gigengʼorego,
to dhier e kethruok mar jochan.
Pok joma kare kelonegi ngima,
to mwandu ma joricho yudo kelonegi kum.
Ngʼat mawinjo weche mirieyego wuotho e yo madhiyo e ngima,
to ngʼat motamore kethone tero ji mamoko e yor lal.
Ngʼatno mapando sigu manie chunye,
dhoge nigi miriambo, to ngʼatno ma jakwoth ofuwo.
Ka weche ngʼeny, to richo ok nyal bare ma ok obetie,
to ngʼat marito lewe oriek.
Lew ngʼat makare en fedha mowal,
to chuny ngʼat marach nigi ohala matin.
Dho ngʼat makare konyo ji mangʼeny,
to ngʼat mofuwo tho nikech rem mar ngʼeyo ngʼado bura.
Gweth mar Jehova Nyasaye kelo mwandu,
kendo ok omed chandruok kuome.
Ngʼat mofuwo yudo mor e timbe maricho,
to ngʼat man-gi winjo bedo mamor kuom rieko.
Gima ngʼat marach oluoro biro loye;
to gima ngʼat makare dwaro ibiro miye.
Ka auka mager ofuto, to joricho otieko;
to joma kare chungo motegno nyaka chiengʼ.
Mana kaka kong awayo machamo lak kendo ka iro malungo wenge,
e kaka jasamuoyo ni jogo moore.
Luoro Jehova Nyasaye miyo idak amingʼa,
to higni mar ngʼat marach ingʼado bedo machwok.
Geno mar joma kare en mor,
to geno mar joricho nolal nono.
Yor Jehova Nyasaye e kar pondo ni joma kare,
to en kethruok ni jogo matimo richo.
Joma kare ok nopudh ngangʼ,
to joricho ok nodongʼ e piny.
Dho joma kare kelo rieko,
to lep mar richo nongʼad oko.
Lew joma kare ongʼeyo gima owinjore,
to dho joricho wacho mana gik mochido.
